messages:
linh: Heads-up — target deploy tonight 23:00 UTC for gradient-routing. Need a deploy owner, smoke lead, and rollback ready. Window ~30m. Ramp plan: 0 -> 15% over 20m, then to 50% after green checks, then gradual to 100%. Cohort split: US-west 10%, US-east 5%, EU mirror 5% (seed).
maria: I can own the deploy window (maria). I'll be on call for the whole window.
zach: I'll own smoke validation post-deploy. Quick Q: what exact metrics do we want me to watch?
linh: Key items to watch: p50/p95 latency, error-rate (5xx + user-facing failures), token/sec, KV cache hit%. Smoke checklist: 
```
- Verify deploy tag and image
- run ./scripts/smoke_grad.sh
- check /dashboards/routing and /dashboards/ingress
- validate 5 sample queries via traffic mirror
- confirm fallback toggle available
```
Please paste results here.
eva: Quick rollback check: we have backout tag gradient-v0.9 and traffic-shift rollback script ready. @raj can you confirm capacity for fallback nodes and that the rollback docs are reachable?
raj: Confirmed. Rollback playbook practiced last week. I will watch gpu-queue, request queues, and can trigger fallback if error-rate > 3% sustained for 5m or if p95 spikes > 200ms over baseline.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: gradient-routing at 2026-03-18T23:00:00Z by linh. Canary ramp: 0 -> 15% over 20m -> 50% after green -> 100% in 2h. Runbook: https://tiny.red/grad-deploy.
zach: :thumbsup: I'll run the smoke script and post the results in-thread.
maria: Small ask — is the runtime timeout tweak PR merged? I saw an unresolved comment. If it's not merged, we should either merge or pin old config. @zach did you finish the review?
zach: I left one comment on timeouts. I'll apply a tiny patch now and push before deploy (should be <10m).
linh: Final owner recap: deploy = maria, smoke = zach, rollback = raj. Runway: monitor for 30m after each ramp stage, call rollback if thresholds hit. Ping here when you start and finish each stage. :rocket:
eva: I'll seed EU with a 5% localization cohort. If p95 > 300ms we abort EU seed.
maria: I'll start prechecks at 22:55 UTC and push at 23:00.
zach: Smoke results after first ramp: all green. p95 +10ms, errors 0.2%. Moving to 50%.
maria: 50% looks stable from my side. Proceeding to full ramp when ready.
raj: Monitoring during the 100% sweep — queues and infra look nominal. No rollback needed.
linh: Closing the loop — deploy-id grad-4169991234, rollforward successful. Thanks all for quick responses. Will add postmortem notes to the release doc.
